agents.name: Dataset Curator
agents.task: Curate 25-30 photos, crop to 1024x576 (16:9) or 1024x1024 (square), write captions with trigger word, package for Google Drive upload
constraints: Read-only on research files. Write only to dataset/ directory.

agents.name: Cloud Environment Setup
agents.task: Set up free-tier cloud environment: Kaggle P100 16GB for training, Google Colab T4 16GB for generation, HuggingFace Hub for model storage, Google Drive 15GB for dataset/outputs. Document notebook setup and session management strategy.
constraints: Read-only. Document setup steps only — do not rent GPUs.

agents.name: ComfyUI Workflow Designer
agents.task: Design ComfyUI workflow JSON for HunyuanVideo 1.5 I2V (14GB VRAM) with camera control and ControlNet stacking. Also design LTX-Video 2B (8GB) fallback workflow. Pin ComfyUI version. Validate against /object_info endpoint.
constraints: Read-only. Design workflows only — do not execute.

agents.name: SDXL LoRA Trainer
agents.task: Train SDXL DreamBooth LoRA on curated dataset using Kohya_ss on Kaggle P100 16GB. Use fp16 + gradient checkpointing to fit 16GB VRAM. Validate identity with ArcFace cosine similarity (>0.7 = good). Upload LoRA weights to HuggingFace Hub.
constraints: Use inference-time lora_scale, NOT fuse_lora(). Expect 2-3 iterations. Kaggle 30h/week limit.

agents.name: HunyuanVideo LoRA Trainer
agents.task: Train HunyuanVideo 1.5 I2V LoRA using official Muon optimizer training code on Kaggle P100 16GB. 10-15 images sufficient for human characters. Upload LoRA weights to HuggingFace Hub.
constraints: Optional — Track B. Requires video clips. 14GB VRAM min with offloading.

agents.name: Cinematic Reference Image Generator
agents.task: Generate 3-5 cinematic reference images per target scene (10 scenes = 30-50 images) using SDXL + LoRA + Five Pillars prompt framework on Google Colab T4. Output at 1024x576 (16:9) to match HunyuanVideo 1.5 input. Use lora_scale 0.8-1.2 at inference (NOT fuse_lora). Save to Google Drive with metadata.
constraints: Depends on Wave 2 sdxl_lora. Generate at HunyuanVideo 1.5 aspect ratio.

agents.name: Video Clip Generator
agents.task: Generate 5s 720P/24fps cinematic video clips from reference images using HunyuanVideo 1.5 I2V on Google Colab T4 16GB with model offloading. Use anchor-frame workflow: last frame of clip N = first frame of clip N+1. Fallback to LTX-Video 2B if HunyuanVideo OOMs. Save raw clips to Google Drive.
constraints: Depends on Wave 3. 16GB VRAM — use model offloading. Save clips immediately (Colab disconnects).

agents.name: Post-Processing Pipeline Setup
agents.task: Set up GFPGAN → Real-ESRGAN → RIFE chain as Colab notebook cells. Prepare FaceFusion 3.6 as backup. Document exact commands and 16GB VRAM requirements.
constraints: Can run in parallel with video_gen. Set up only — do not process clips yet.

agents.name: Video Post-Processor
agents.task: Run GFPGAN → Real-ESRGAN → RIFE chain on all raw clips. Apply FaceFusion backup if identity drift detected. Output final 1080p+ 48fps clips.
constraints: Depends on Wave 4. ~20-40 min per clip on Colab T4 (slower than 4090).

agents.name: Final Assembly Editor
agents.task: Assemble processed clips in DaVinci Resolve (free). Add audio (Piper TTS for voiceover, royalty-free music from YouTube Audio Library, Freesound for SFX). Color grade with Shot Match + cinematic LUTs. Export 1080p master + vertical social cuts.
constraints: Depends on postproc. Manual editing in DaVinci Resolve.
